_readme: Per-development registry for the interactive lot-map pipeline. Each development (a plat/map) belongs to exactly one tenant (an organizations.slug). Scripts accept --development <slug> and resolve tenant/source/tiers/out-dir from here, so Hopkins Grove lots can never be published into another tenant's account — and onboarding Sagana Heights (or any future plat) is one entry plus its tiers file. Explicit flags (--tenant/--source/--tiers/--out/--dir) override the registry, except a --tenant that conflicts with the registry is refused.
